acceptance: every run-wide gate passes; otherwise the score is 0 and the result is a trusted gate failure

fidelity.family: arithmetic mean over the family's items
fidelity.primary: 100 x mean over 500, 750, 875 per mille eviction
fidelity.ratio: geometric mean over retrieval, aggregation, qa, generation

gates.latency_denominator: trusted plain prefill of the same context, same GPU, Phase B

reference.phase_a: unprivileged worker: context-only prefill, candidate select, validated selections stored as per-(layer, head) bitmasks
reference.phase_b: trusted replay: plain prefill, reference continuation, bitmask re-validation, teacher-forced full and compressed replay with kept pairs in position order
